description: PrepVista Part 6: Offer -> Acceptance -> Joining -> Verified Placement Outcome

dependencies._comment: The tested core (services/, events/, schemas/) has ZERO runtime dependencies - it only uses Node built-ins. The packages below are only needed if you wire up api/*/routes.js as-is; swap for whatever your host app already uses.

peerDependenciesComment: A real integration also needs: a Postgres client/ORM for migrations/001_offers_joining_placement.sql, and your existing CSV/XLSX parser feeding services/offers/bulkImport.js.
